title: parse_subject: base_subject can be empty string violating documented invariant
description: lib.rs:126-128 documents: 'base_subject is never empty when SubjectParts is returned'. But parse_subject("(1/3)") returns Some(SubjectParts { base_subject: "", ... }) because the matched span covers the entire stripped input, leaving both before and after empty. The code path at subject.rs:195-196 returns after.to_string() (an empty string) when before is empty. The documented invariant is violated on any subject that consists solely of a part marker with no surrounding text. Callers using base_subject as a HashMap key will collapse all bare-marker posts into a single bucket keyed by "".
